rules.snapshot_time: Evaluate source events and telemetry as of dataset_version.as_of_utc.
rules.adoption: Use the latest 30-day active-repository coverage. Flag a stall when coverage is at least 10 percentage points below target and improvement versus a comparable 28–35 day old snapshot is at most 3 points.
rules.adoption_quality: Missing data, telemetry older than 7 days, insufficient history, and scope or denominator changes result in verify_data.
rules.expansion: A first-party email or meeting must establish an open discovery request from a member of the prospective buying group within 60 days. The event must explicitly link to that group and participant.
rules.context: An optional market event from the same group within 45 days and incumbent adoption can inform discovery. Discovery status remains separate from committed funding or signed revenue.
rules.health: Churn risk and account health are dated CSM assessments. Coverage is a product adoption measure. Observed value is scoped to the deployment and reporting window.
rules.action_boundary: MCP can read owned tasks and append a user-directed update to the warehouse. The action register tracks the accountable CSM separately from the customer contact.
rules.account_identifiers: account_id is stable alphanumeric text. account_name is the CRM display label. Prior aliases resolve via account_alias.
rules.licensing: Licensed seats are purchased contract entitlements. For contributor contracts, utilization is 90-day active contributing developers divided by licensed seats. The portfolio ratio is displayed only for a single active contract. Review contract-level detail for multiple agreements.
rules.portfolio_adoption: The portfolio adoption rate uses the sole active deployment with fresh coverage. Review deployment-level rates when an account has multiple active scopes.
rules.action_revision: Update the current revision. A completion can create one dated follow-up atomically. A retry with the same revision, editor and outcome reuses the recorded result.
rules.lifecycle_results: First scans, sponsor acknowledgement, risk reassessment and expansion funding retain their own source evidence. Recording a CSM task outcome preserves those source facts.
rules.evidence_event: An event is a dated source record. A case or workstream references its event ID when it supports the decision.
rules.observation: The demo links a curated statement or measurable fact to a product capability, buying group, and source record or exact message. SQL calculates telemetry changes separately.
rules.workstream: A seeded CSM objective ties a scoped product use case and supporting event to accountable actions. Qualifying cases can link to the workstream.
rules.expansion_research: Simulated Sumble signals describe the organization and its initiatives. Simulated Clay profiles suggest people and roles within the scoped target entity. The existing discovery case comes from first-party evidence.
rules.identity_match: An exact work email joins a person to CRM and first-party marketing within the account. Matching the target buying group and entity is required for use in outreach.
rules.stakeholder_intent: The historical engagement agent combines exact stakeholder activity, scoped colleague observations, and simulated company signals. It outputs conditional hypotheses with evidence IDs, the reason each resource matters, timing, and a product fit to validate.
rules.outreach_drafts: A relevant attributed question and current discovery can support a direct stakeholder 1:1. Passive engagement and uncertain involvement can support a warm introduction through the evaluator. The saved draft includes the generated copy, recipient, workstream and evidence.
rules.outreach_approval: Approval captures an exact copy revision. An edit before queueing reopens review. The simulated Gong assignment uses the approved subject and body and queues a manual email step. Replaying the same transition at the same revision reuses it.
rules.outreach_activity: The simulated send and each simulated reply become labeled timeline events. The draft and the queued task remain workflow records. Simulated email activity is excluded from discovery qualification and first-party history.

data_flow.title: Source records
data_flow.description: Original emails, CRM, support, telemetry, enablement activity and simulated market signals carry a source and date. Simulated Sumble and Clay records supply expansion research.

data_flow.title: Canonical warehouse
data_flow.description: The warehouse links evidence to buying groups and product capabilities. It stores action updates, generated email copy and each review and delivery revision.

data_flow.title: Knowledge layer
data_flow.description: SQL computes telemetry and eligibility. The graph links qualifying observations to decisions. The historical engagement agent builds a point of view from stakeholder, colleague and company evidence.

data_flow.title: Console and MCP
data_flow.description: CSMs can open evidence, review drafts and approve exact copy in the console or through MCP. User-directed changes write to the warehouse.

data_flow.title: Gong Engage simulation
data_flow.description: An approved draft queues a simulated manual email task with the recipient, owner and individualized copy. Simulated sends and replies appear in the account timeline.
